headline: Fisherman's Row Rebuilt Whole as Stlican Shelf Flares Anew
war_summary: Since our last edition, Fisherman's Row has been made whole: every one of its nine strongpoints now flies Colonial colors after the ruins were rebuilt, though stray firing lingers there. In Viper Pit the fighting has cooled as quickly as it rose; the ledger reads eight posts to none in Colonial hands, Moltworth having drawn every recent action. Stlican Shelf grows hotter by the hour — Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost again the scenes of struggle, one Warden post laid waste, the count six Colonial flags to two, the hourly toll past two hundred a side and climbing. The Weathered Expanse keeps its dreadful arithmetic, eight holdings to one, its casualties still mounting. Callahan's Passage remains the war's busiest ground: The Latch alone drew forty-one actions, and a day's losses there top twelve thousand on either side. Nevish Line's flare has eased, though eleven actions fell within six hours around Princefal and its neighbors. Mooring County, too, bleeds heavily even as its posts stand quiet. It is day 431 of the war; thirty-four victory towns will decide the issue, and no victor is named.
